integrity: The proof is self-contained. Standalone finite verification is corroborative, not an infinite proof. No external independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to three-symbol linear homopolymer-free words and factors of length at most two; class cardinalities and decoding complexity are not determined. Relevant 2018 chapter full text unavailable; an unindexed equivalent derivation remains possible.
title: Exact 2-abelian reconstruction capacity of homopolymer-free ternary words
